name: agribalyse-3.2-extra-unit-conversions
description: Unit conversions used by AGB technosphere edges that the upstream randonneur 'generic-brightway-unit-conversions' datapackage doesn't ship. Ported verbatim from scripts/link_all.py@8020481 UNIT_CONVERSIONS dict — needed because AGB SimaPro CSV expresses land/transport edges in m²/m while ecoinvent targets are in hectare/km. Also covers gas-resource volume equivalence (m³ ≡ Sm³ at standard conditions) needed by AGB natural-gas resource bridges. Per builder.py the extras file is read FIRST in the dedup so corrected entries override broken upstream ones — used to fix the s/min/day/year ↔ hour multipliers, which the upstream datapackage ships inverted (e.g. s→hour=3600 instead of 1/3600). The inverted values compound 3600^2 through any supply chain that touches power sawing or other time-billed services and are the dominant cause of the post-refactor backtest's 21× CC over-estimate.
